reconstruction_basis.join_rule: Immutable unit_id join between execution result and frozen fixture; no post-hoc recoding or imputation.

Q1.basis: condition is retained in the frozen fixture and f/presented_profiles are reconstructable by unit_id; INFORMATIVE and UNINFORMATIVE_NULL are therefore distinguishable without regenerating the fixture.
Q1.blocking_issue: The specification does not yet give one exact frozen model formula, coefficient target, reference coding and primary contrast definition for the condition-by-profile correspondence test.

Q2.basis: presentation is explicitly retained in every execution-result decision record and crossed by the frozen 24 profile permutations.
Q2.blocking_issue: The specification leaves the set of presentation interaction terms and the declared inferential family insufficiently enumerated for an execution-ready analysis.

Q3.basis: condition is recoverable from the immutable fixture and all four conditions are part of the frozen cardinality.
Q3.blocking_issue: The specification does not fully predefine the exact estimand/model for each of the three declared condition contrasts.

Q4.basis: domain, operationalisation, presentation, replicate and permutation_index are retained; the fixture binds all four domains, five operationalisations, four presentations and three repetitions.
Q4.blocking_issue: The specification does not predefine which factor interactions are inferential targets versus descriptive robustness summaries, nor the exact estimand for each.

Q5.basis: action identity, f/action-to-profile assignment, condition, permutation_index and selected action are reconstructable from immutable records.
Q5.blocking_issue: The phrase 'action-by-assigned-profile/correspondence structure' is not yet an execution-level model specification; exact coding and target coefficient/contrast must be frozen.

important_finding: The missing condition field in the execution-result decision records does not make Q1-Q4 impossible: condition is an immutable fixture attribute and can be joined by unit_id. However, this join must be explicitly specified in the final analysis implementation contract.
required_next_action: Create a superseding post-primary discrimination analysis specification that freezes exact model formulas, reference levels, target coefficients/contrasts, factor-interaction set, contrast family cardinality, and the immutable fixture/result join before any scientific execution.
interpretation: The frozen NEXT3 data contain the variables required to address Q1-Q5. The current post-primary specification is not yet sufficiently exact to execute reproducibly. No scientific analysis has been executed under this specification.
